HELD, AND THE RETAINED CANDIDATE IS NOW ON THE WRONG CONCEPT — which is the thing to notice here. OB06 was RE-RULED on 2026-09-05: it is FETAL DEMISE, the baby has died in the womb, because a Kinyarwanda speaker confirms 'ntagikina' means died and that no natural phrase says 'reduced movement'. Sheet draft D024 ('le bebe ne bouge plus dans mon ventre') and the English brief's 'the baby is no longer moving in my stomach' both describe REDUCED OR ABSENT MOVEMENT, which is now OB13's concept, not this one. So the French candidate and the entire English row are attached to a concept that no longer exists at this id. Nothing is drafted: the hold is for a clinician, on whether the urgency change to CRITICAL is right and whether fetal demise belongs in a triage taxonomy at all, since it is the one presentation here where no intervention follows.

NOT DRAFTED, ON THE SPEAKER'S RULING — AND FRENCH IS EVIDENCE ON THE QUESTION THAT RULING LEFT OPEN. OB13 was opened on 2026-09-05 to hold 'reduced fetal movement' when OB06 was re-ruled to fetal demise, so that the actionable half of the old concept did not vanish silently: a mother who notices less movement can be seen in time, a demise cannot. It has no phrase and is NOT awaiting one; the speaker reports Kinyarwanda has no natural expression for it, and the recorded instruction is do not draft. Respected here. BUT THE OPEN QUESTION IS 'does this presentation need to exist in the corpus if no natural Kinyarwanda phrase expresses it', and the French answer to the lexical half is that French expresses it perfectly ordinarily — 'le bebe bouge moins que d'habitude'. So the premise is Kinyarwanda-specific, and a corpus that drafts it in French and not in Kinyarwanda would be the EX43 divergence at its maximum: a concept present in one language and absent in another. Recorded rather than acted on. This is the sharpest case in the arm of the wording-gap against content-gap distinction NE05 introduced, and it runs the other way — here the gap decides whether the concept survives at all.
Held with the first. Also pinned out of generation in the target arithmetic, subtracted as a concept exactly as PR02 is.
